about: Seed lessons for perch_read: what any reader of screen pixels gets wrong, known before it has learned anything on a screen. A screen's own lessons (learned against its apps' words) count first; these only fill in. Junk: bits read at the ends of a line that are not words (window borders, icons, cursors). Numbers and words: look-alike characters, changed only where the rest of the word says which it is.
